request.style: English, male solo voice, piano, acoustic guitar, cello, strings, hopeful and anthemic, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
It was credited to him as righteousness
Not written for his sake alone
But for us who believe today
In the Lord who rose from the dead

[Chorus]
He was handed over to death
For our trespasses and shame
And he was raised for our justification
A new life in his name

[Verse]
We believe in him who raised Jesus
Our Lord from the dead
The words stand true for us now
Who place our trust in God

[Chorus]
He was handed over to death
For our trespasses and shame
And he was raised for our justification
A new life in his name

[Bridge]
Credited to us who believe
The promise holds for all
Through the cross and the empty grave
We stand in grace and call

[Outro]
He was raised for our justification
He was raised for our justification
